question: What will be the area of a triangle whose sides are 13 cm, 5 cm and 12 cm?
solution:
**Given:**

A triangle whose sides are 13 cm, 5 cm and 12 cm.

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle with sides a, b, c and perimeter '2s'

⇒ sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)} .

s=(a+b+c)/(2)

**Calculation:**

The semi perimeter of the triangle is,

⇒ s=(13+5+12)/(2)=(30)/(2)=15cm..

Area = sqrt{15(15-13)(15-5)(15-12)}.

⇒ sqrt{15×2×10×3}

⇒ sqrt{900}=30cm²

**∴ The area of the given triangle is 30cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**5, 12, and 13 is the triplet of the right angle triangle

Formula used:

Area of triangle = 1/2 (Base × Height)

Calculation:

Area of triangle = 1/2 (Base × Height)

⇒ 1/2 (5 × 12)

⇒ 30 cm².

∴ The area of the given triangle is 30cm2.
